# bioexcel/biobb_mem/gorder_aa

## Summary

Wrapper of the gorder atomistic module for computing lipid order parameters per atom for carbon tails.

gorder uses GSL for all its selections.

Nextflow adapter of the [GorderAA](https://biobb-mem.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gorder.html#module-gorder.gorder_aa) building block of [biobb_mem](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_mem) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_MEM_GORDER_AA } from 'bioexcel/biobb_mem/gorder_aa'

workflow {
    BIOBB_MEM_GORDER_AA(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_top_path` | yes | tpr | Path to the input structure or topology file |
| `input_traj_path` | yes | xtc, trr, gro | Path to the input trajectory to be processed |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_order_path` | yes | yaml, xvg, csv | Path to results of the order analysis |
| `versions_biobb_mem` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_mem', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of GorderAA properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_order_path: 'yaml']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_mem container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_MEM_GORDER_AA' {
        ext.properties = [heavy_atoms: '@membrane and name rC3.+|C2.+']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `heavy_atoms` | string | "@membrane and name rC3.+\|C2.+" | Selection query specifying the heavy atoms to be used in the analysis (typically carbon atoms in lipid tails). |
| `hydrogens` | string | "@membrane and element name hydrogen" | Selection query specifiying the hydrogen atoms to be used in the analysis (only those bonded to heavy atoms will be considered). |
| `handle_pbc` | boolean | true | If False, ignores periodic boundary conditions (PBC). |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
